en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Guessed: 'Коњ ми вода' (my reading: I water my horse), and the last stanza 'Ушче да бев... црно око' (my reading: even if I were dark-eyed, I would marry the most beautiful girl of the village). 'Пуста таго' is a refrain I rendered loosely.

words_to_learn.en: I was pleased (with myself), I liked it

lines.en: I lead the horse, Anđe, I lead the horse,
my poor sorrow, to water it.

lines.cyr: Коњ ми вода Анѓе, коњ ми вода,
lines.lat: Konj mi voda Anǵe, konj mi voda,
lines.en: I give my horse water, Anđe, my horse,
Angelina, girl, it did not drink,
my poor sorrow, it did not drink.

lines.cyr: Коњ ми тропа Анѓе, коњ ми тропа,
lines.lat: Konj mi tropa Anǵe, konj mi tropa,
lines.en: My horse stamps, Anđe, my horse stamps,
Angelina, girl, with its right foot,

lines.cyr: пуста таго моја, с' десна нога.
lines.lat: pusta tago moja, s' desna noga.
lines.en: my poor sorrow, with its right foot.
It dug up, Anđe, a marble slab,
under the slab, Anđe, a mirror,
I looked at myself, Anđe, I looked at myself,
Angelina, girl, I liked what I saw,
my poor sorrow, I liked what I saw.

lines.cyr: Ушче да бев Анѓе, црно око,
lines.lat: Ušče da bev Anǵe, crno oko,
lines.en: Even if I were, Anđe, dark-eyed,
I would marry, Anđe, the most beautiful,
my poor sorrow, in the village.
